name: Tsujidou Ai
source: The main heroine of the series, Ai is an animal-loving delinquent nicknamed "Fighting Wolf" and the daughter of the well-known delinquent "Inamura Chain". She is respected among the other delinquents and feared by the normal students.
translation: The main heroine of the series, Ai is an animal-loving delinquent nicknamed "Fighting Wolf" and the daughter of the well-known delinquent "Inamura Chain". She is respected among the other delinquents and feared by the normal students.
